newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK FINMIN SETS STATE BOND AUCTION FOR JUNE 17.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK FINMIN SETS STATE BOND AUCTION FOR JUNE 17.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction an unspecified tranche of one-year state bonds on June 17, the central bank (NBS) said in statement on Wednesday.
The bond, with a nominal value of 100,000 crowns, will carry a fixed annual coupon rate of 10.00 percent.
The ministry does not set the amount of state securities affered at its auctions, nor does it set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.
Average yield in the last successful auction of one-year state bonds on May 27 rose to 15.868 percent, from 14.88 percent in the previous auction of similar bonds on March 25.

The ministry uses treasury bills and state bonds as its main tools to cover the budget deficit, which totalled 3.45 billion crowns in the first quarter of 1997, up from 361 million in the first two months of this year.
